companyFieldUpdates.description: Undine is a Houston-based regulated water and wastewater utility platform that acquires and operates systems across Texas. Ridgewood Infrastructure and Crosstimbers Capital Group have both provided equity funding since 2017 and continue to list Undine as an unrealized investment. Public sources do not disclose their exact percentages, control rights or acquisition SPVs. A reported 2025 sale process was not found to have produced a signed or closed transaction through September 1, 2026.
